# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 1.x     | :white_check_mark: |

Only the latest `1.x` release receives security fixes. Older tags are not patched -- upgrade to the latest release to get a fix.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please **do not** open a public GitHub issue for security vulnerabilities.

Report vulnerabilities privately via [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/jeffersongoncalves/laravel-service-desk/security/advisories/new) for this repository. You'll receive an acknowledgement and, once the report is triaged, a timeline for a fix.

If the vulnerability is confirmed, a patched release will be cut and the advisory published (with credit to the reporter, unless anonymity is requested) once the fix is available.
